prayerExcerpt.en-US: "Be humble, without any pretension, loving to please others, and you will always be happy."
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: "Sede humildes, sem nenhuma pretensão, gostando de agradar aos outros, e sereis sempre felizes."

meta.face: A sturdy Québécoise of about sixty-five with a fair complexion and a WIDE, FLAT, RECTANGULAR face closely framed by the coif — a broad, smooth forehead, STRAIGHT, heavy dark brows, small, DEEP-SET, pale, steady eyes, a SHORT, straight nose with a broad base, a notably LONG, FLAT upper lip, a straight, THIN-lipped mouth firmly closed, full, flat cheeks and a broad chin; the gaze level and steady, toward us.
meta.basis: Her photographs of 1906 (Centre Marie-Léonie Paradis, on Wikimedia Commons) and the Dicastery's portrait: a wide, flat, rectangular face in a stiff white coif, straight heavy brows over small deep-set eyes, a short nose, a long upper lip and a thin, straight mouth. Sherbrooke is where the motherhouse moved in 1895 and where she died.
meta.excerpt: Her counsel to her sisters, «soyez humbles, sans aucune prétention, aimant faire plaisir aux autres et vous serez toujours heureuses», as quoted by Vatican News (October 2024; fuller in Marie de Nazareth's '1000 raisons de croire'); our rendering (she died in 1912)
